name: webkul/bagisto-sync-for-woocommerce
description: A WooCommerce addon by Webkul to seamlessly connect and sync WooCommerce store data with Bagisto.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run a PHP syntax check over every PHP file in the plugin.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Check the codebase against the WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Automatically fix the coding-standard violations that can be fixed safely.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run the full static-analysis suite (syntax + coding standards).
